results.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
results.evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'

combo_sqls.focused_short:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND s.Virtual = 'F';
combo_sqls.focused_long:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s
  ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND s.Virtual = 'F';
combo_sqls.full_short:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.CDSCode) AS num_exclusively_virtual_schools
FROM satscores AS t1
JOIN schools AS t2
  ON t1.cds = t2.CDSCode
WHERE t2.Virtual = 'F'
  AND t1.AvgScrMath > 400;
combo_sqls.full_long:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s
  ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
  AND t.AvgScrMath > 400;
combo_sqls.focused_full:

FROM satscores AS ss
JOIN schools AS sc
  ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F';

results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

results.question: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
results.evidence: male refers to SEX = 'M'; in-patient refers to Admission = '+'; outpatient refers to Admission = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(ID) where SEX = 'M' and Admission = '+', COUNT(ID) where SEX  = 'M' and Admission = '-')

combo_sqls.focused_short:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
         SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <
         SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS more_male_group,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) -
   CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)) * 100.0 /
  NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient;
combo_sqls.focused_long:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN in_cnt > out_cnt THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN out_cnt > in_cnt THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS more_male_group,
  (CAST(ABS(in_cnt - out_cnt) AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF((in_cnt + out_cnt), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_cnt
  FROM Patient
);

  -

FROM Patient;

    WHEN out_male > in_male THEN 'outpatient'

  (CAST(in_male - out_male AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(out_male, 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_male,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_male

);
